description: Video & GIF Generation Skill - Claude Code skill that records browser workflows as video and converts them to high-quality GIFs using agent-browser and ffmpeg

userStories.title: Create skill directory and SKILL.md with frontmatter
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the skill directory and SKILL.md file created with valid YAML frontmatter so the skill can be loaded by Claude Code.
acceptanceCriteria: Directory created at .claude/skills/video-gif-generation/
SKILL.md created with valid YAML frontmatter including name and description
Description includes trigger keywords: record workflow, create gif, record demo, browser recording, workflow gif, screen recording
SKILL.md body contains a placeholder heading and brief intro referencing agent-browser skill
Skill file is under 3000 words
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add prerequisite validation instructions to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As Claude, I need instructions in the skill to verify that agent-browser and ffmpeg are installed before attempting a recording.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md includes a Prerequisites section
Instructions to run agent-browser --version and check for success
Instructions to run ffmpeg -version and check for success (only when GIF output requested)
Clear error messages with install instructions if either tool is missing
Prerequisite check runs once at the start of the workflow, not repeated per step
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add viewport and display configuration instructions to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As a product team member, I want Claude to configure the browser viewport and color scheme before recording starts for consistent output.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md includes a Configuration section with default settings table
Default viewport is 1280x720 configured via agent-browser before recording
Light mode set by default using agent-browser set media light
Instructions for user to override viewport dimensions and color scheme
Default FPS is 12 (range 5-30), default max width is 800px (range 320-1920)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add recording workflow orchestration instructions to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As a product team member, I want Claude to record a browser workflow so I get a video file of the automation.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md documents full recording lifecycle: configure viewport, start recording, execute actions, stop recording
Recording starts with agent-browser record start <output-path>.webm
Browser actions execute between start and stop using agent-browser skill commands
agent-browser wait --load networkidle used after navigation to ensure pages load
Recording stops with agent-browser record stop
Output .webm file verified to exist and be non-empty after recording stops
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add output path and naming convention instructions to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As a user, I want sensible default output paths so I don't have to specify where to save files.
acceptanceCriteria: Default output directory is the current working directory
If user provides a name (e.g. demo), output is demo.gif or demo.webm
If user provides a full path, that path is used as-is
Intermediate .webm stored alongside the final output
If output file already exists, Claude asks before overwriting
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add video-to-GIF conversion instructions to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As a product team member, I want to convert the recorded video into a high-quality GIF with configurable quality settings.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md includes the ffmpeg command template with palettegen and paletteuse filters
Lanczos scaling used for high-quality downscaling
GIF loops infinitely by default (-loop 0)
User can override FPS (5-30) and max width (320-1920)
Intermediate .webm file deleted after successful GIF conversion
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add error handling instructions to SKILL.md
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear feedback when something goes wrong during recording so I know what happened and how to fix it.
acceptanceCriteria: If agent-browser record start fails, Claude reports error and stops
If a browser action fails during recording, Claude stops recording, saves capture, and reports failure
If ffmpeg conversion fails, Claude preserves the .webm file and reports the conversion error
If output .webm is empty (0 bytes), Claude reports that recording captured nothing
Error messages are actionable with suggestions for fixing the issue
Typecheck passes
